# Hand model attribution

Source: immersive-web/webxr-input-profiles, packages/assets/profiles/generic-hand/{left,right}.glb
https://github.com/immersive-web/webxr-input-profiles/tree/main/packages/assets/profiles/generic-hand
Retrieved 2026-10-14. Assets license: MIT, retained in LICENSE.md.

The original continuous skinned meshes and XR bones are used locally. Piano animation, bind-space retargeting and constrained segment-length IK are implemented by this project. No third-party typing-ai code is copied.
